cards.q: Find the odd one out: 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32
cards.sol: All others are powers of 2 (2, 2^2, 2, 2, 2). 24 is not a power of 2.

cards.q: Find the odd one out: 27, 64, 125, 216, 300
Find the odd one out: 27, 64, 125, 216, 341
cards.sol: 27 = 3^3, 64 = 4^3, 125 = 5^3 and 216 = 6^3 are perfect cubes. 341 is not a perfect cube (7^3 = 343), so 341 is the odd one out.

cards.q: Find the odd one out: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 42
Find the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 125, 200, 343
Find the odd one out: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Moon
cards.sol: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars are planets. Moon is a natural satellite.

cards.q: Find the odd one out: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Wolf, Cheetah
cards.sol: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Cheetah are cats (Felidae). Wolf is a dog (Canidae).

Find the option that best completes the analogy. AC: FH:: BD:?
cards.sol: Given: AC: FH:: BD:? Logic: Letters are increasing + 5 place. For, AC: FH A + 5 = F, C + 5 = H Similarly, BD:? B + 5 = G, D + 5 = I So, BD: G I Thus, correct option is (c).

cards.q: Find the option that best completes the analogy. DP: XZ:: EN:?
cards.sol: Analogy: DP: XZ:: EN:? Logic: 1st letter +20, 2nd letter +10. Explanation: Logic: First letter → +20, Second letter → +10. Step-by-step: DP → XZ • D(4) + 20 = X(24) • P(16) + 10 = Z(26) Apply same to EN: • E(5) + 20 = Y(25) • N(14) + 10 = X(24) So, EN → YX

cards.q: Find the part of the sentence that contains an err or: The fact that citizens have no remedy available (1)/ when environmental breaches are ignored at the ministerial level (2)/ highlight a broader decline in (3)/ constitutional accountability. (4)
cards.sol: The correct option is cIn this sentence, the real subject is 'The fact', which is singular. The clause beginning with 'that citizens have no remedy available...' only describes the noun 'fact' and does not change its singular nature. Therefore, the verb must be singular. In part (3), the verb is written as 'highlight' (plural verb), but it should be 'highlights' (singular verb) to agree with the s

cards.q: Find the perpendicular distance from the point (1,2) to the line 3x + 4y − 10 = 0.
cards.sol: Shortcut: Distance = |Ax₀+By₀+C|/√(A²+B²) = |3·1+4·2−10|/√(9+16) = |1|/5 = 1/5. Full solution: Substitute the point into the line equation, take absolute value, divide by the square root of the sum of squares of coefficients to get 1/5.
